_: Documents and the exact problems both check twins report for them: the Workflow schema (schema.invalid), the meta-check of api.input (api.input.invalid) and references out of a schema (schema.remoteRef). WorkflowSchemaTest and test/workflow-schema.test.ts read this file.

cases.name: a clean file
cases.yaml:
apiVersion: iaf.platform/v1
kind: Workflow
metadata: { name: vm-info, title: VM info, noun: vm, verb: read, owner: team-compute, version: 1.0.0 }
api:
  input:
    type: object
    required: [vmId]
    properties:
      vmId: { type: string }
policy:
  rbac: [ops]
workflow:
  do:
    - getVm:
        name: Get VM
        call: provider
        with: { provider: vsphere, action: vm.get, input: { id: "{{ $input.vmId }}" } }

cases.name: unknown step keys
cases.yaml:
apiVersion: iaf.platform/v1
kind: Workflow
metadata: { name: vm-info, title: VM info, noun: vm, verb: read, owner: team-compute, version: 1.0.0 }
api:
  input:
    type: object
    required: [vmId]
    properties:
      vmId: { type: string }
policy:
  rbac: [ops]
workflow:
  do:
    - getVm:
        name: Get VM
        call: provider
        with: { provider: vsphere, action: vm.get, input: { id: "{{ $input.vmId }}" } }
        loop: 3
        retries: 2

problems.message: /workflow/do/0/getVm: property 'loop' is not defined in the schema and the schema does not allow additional properties
/workflow/do/0/getVm: property 'retries' is not defined in the schema and the schema does not allow additional properties
required property 'metadata' not found
